parameters.name: IncludeMediaInfo
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include media information in the returned result.

*   Valid values: true and false.
*   Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: IncludePlayList
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include playback information in the returned result.

*   Valid values: true and false.
*   Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: IncludeSnapshotList
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include snapshot information in the returned result.

*   Valid values: true and false.
*   Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: IncludeSummaryList
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include summaries in the returned result.

*   Valid values: true and false.
*   Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: MediaIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the media files. To obtain the ID of a media file, you can perform the following operations in the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console: In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Media Management** > **Media List**. Find the required video and click Manage. The ID of the video is displayed on the Basics tab. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can query up to 10 media files at a time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts query-media-list --media-ids 3e1cd21131a94525be55acf658880000,e26cfa29e784402388463f61dbec0000 --include-play-list true --include-snapshot-list true --include-media-info true --include-summary-list true --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mts QueryMediaList --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeSummaryList true --IncludeSnapshotList true --IncludeMediaInfo true --IncludePlayList true --MediaIds '3e1cd21131a94525be55acf658880000,e26cfa29e784402388463f61dbec0000'
